title: Man with a Plan (TV series)
premise_summary: Man with a Plan is an American television sitcom created by Jackie and Jeff Filgo and starring Matt LeBlanc, who also served as an executive producer. The series ran on CBS from October 24, 2016, to June 11, 2020, airing for 69 episodes over 4 seasons. The series was a staple on CBS's Monday night comedy lineup for its first three seasons, before being moved to Thursday nights for the fourth and final season.
